description: List every Viator destination (cities, regions, countries) with ids, parent hierarchy, IATA codes, time zones, and coordinates. Use the destinationId with vt_search_products / vt_search_attractions. Reference data — cached.

campaign_value.description: Affiliate campaign tracking id — appended to the productUrl/attractionUrl/destinationUrl Viator returns

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact strips image/avatar URLs from the response; "full" returns Viator's payload untouched. No field projection on this tool — every other field comes back as Viator sent it.

name: vt_list_destinations
